rubric: Evaluate the contract from the public request, issue-time owner decisions, and contemporaneous observable behavior. Require each material decision to include its supported answer, and require observable outcomes and compatible behavior clearly established by those sources. Later patches and tests may diagnose the defect, demonstrate affected outcomes or close analogues, and confirm non-regression, but cannot retroactively require broader coverage or a particular design. Do not convert code structure, algorithms, predicates, representations, helper behavior, control flow, messages, documentation, fixtures, test organization, or other patch-specific choices into requirements unless independently mandated. Penalize missing supported outcomes, unsupported scope expansion, and compatibility regressions; accept any implementation that satisfies the supported observable contract.
